messages.subject: Sanjeev | Energy & Natural Resources Executive | ESG, Government Relations and Global Mobility
messages.body:
Dear Sanjeev,

Your leadership across Energy & Natural Resources and Industrial & Manufacturing, together with your work around hydrogen, ESG and energy transition, makes this a focused introduction. I am pursuing senior international mandates where resource-sector growth depends on institutional relationships, responsible business and disciplined execution.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My current remit spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, external and corporate affairs, strategic stakeholder engagement and executive communications for a major gold-mining operation.

My portfolio also includes stakeholder governance around approximately 46-50 MWp of solar capacity, more than 80 MWh of battery storage and carbon-data readiness, giving me direct exposure to the institutional dimensions of industrial decarbonization.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head and VP-track mandates across Government Affairs, External Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Social Performance and Country Leadership in energy, mining, infrastructure and industrial businesses. I am internationally mobile, with strong interest in the Middle East and wider international markets.

I have attached an EMA Partners-tailored executive CV and would value consideration for suitable current or upcoming searches.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
